note: Dates the game files do not contain. 'first_run' = the original run of an expedition as listed by community/news sources (days may be off by one; the in-game Expedition Terminus is authoritative). Expeditions are rerun, mostly in a holiday block (Nov-Jan).

23.note: 10th anniversary expedition; Hello Games announced about six weeks and no exact end date.

facts: An expedition (the game's 'season') is a time-limited event of about six weeks with milestones and phases; the rewards are exclusive and, per the game's own text, phase rewards can be accessed on any save.
Past expeditions come back as reruns, mostly in a holiday block between November and January, so their rewards can be earned later.
